about_the_game:
Oh Roots and Branches! Your Kingdom needs help!

Welcome to Tree Kingdoms, a bite sized 4x strategy game and a surprisingly deep battle for survival. You are the Great Tree Spirit of a cosy woodland kingdom, but winter is coming and resources are scarce. You must secure the forest from rivals before the frost sets in. Can you outwit your foes and prove yourself a strategic master?


Strategic Turn-based action!



Explore the map, claim territory and upgrade your cities! Build an Empire that can stand up to your rivals and see your treelings through the harsh winter. Will you fortify or will you focus on conquest?



The Clock is ticking...

You have a limited amount of time to grow strong enough to survive winter. Stockpile resources & secure safer land in the forest interior where the bite of frost is not so strong. But other Kingdoms and their Tree Spirits won’t sit idly by. The clock is ticking… As time goes on ice will spread in from the cold exterior and make life much more difficult for your Kingdom so there’s no time to waste!



Race against the seasons to secure your victory in this Bite Sized 4x!

Upgrading your cities and gathering new units might be your path to salvation, sometimes surviving is better than fighting. Your Treelings will rely on you to make the right choice. Do you build tall and gather resources? Or do you walk the path of the warlord? It’s all up to you.

Features
=====================================

  • Dynamic map changes with weather-based conditions

  • Specialise your civilisation with unique upgrades and units

  • A three-way battle for survival where enemies fight just as much as you

  • Win by conquest, peace or just surviving

  • Unlock all new factions

Tree Kingdoms is a bite sized 4x Strategy game. With limited turn count you can squeeze in a run whenever it takes your fancy. With infinite replayability you have the power to try out new strategies and new plans, the path to victory isn’t always a straight line. Battling two other teams offers great strategic depth and new surprises each match. A smart leader might even pit enemies against each other whilst they developed in secret…

With no two winters alike, will your Kingdom feast or face famine? It’s in your hands now Great Tree Spirit, lead on.


=====================================

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 1.7+ GHz or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Winter approaches, Great Spirit. Rival Tree Kingdoms peck at your borders... Will you conquer, outlast, or outwit them in this bite-sized turn-based 4X struggle? Command your Treelings, adapt to the seasons, and etch your legend into the bark of history, before the cold claims all.
